column1: # CMS OPPS and ASC labor-related shares by calendar year.
# CMS prices calendar year N OPPS and ASC services with the fiscal year N IPPS wage index
# applied only to the labor-related share: rate * (labor_share * wage_index + (1 - labor_share)).
# OPPS labor-related share is 60% and ASC is 50% in each year's OPPS/ASC final rule.
# Years match the CMS OPPS/ASC final-rule rate data Corvid covers (OPPS CY 2007-CY 2026; ASC CY 2008-CY 2026).
# ASC CY 2007 is omitted: the 50% ASC labor share starts with the revised ASC payment system in CY 2008
# so that year stays undetermined rather than guessed.
